items.Sentence: The freeboard in the effluent storage tanks shall never be less than two feet as measured vertically from the water surface to the lowest point of overflow.
The Discharger’s highest priority shall be to treat and dispose of liquid wastes contained in the Class II surface impoundment.
The Discharger shall implement the items described in Spray Irrigation Management Plan submitted as part of the RWD.
Weeds shall be minimized through control of water depth, harvesting, and/or herbicides.
